example.title: Range Line Road Bridge (Hall Farm Bridge), Range Line Road over the West Branch of the Eau Claire River
example.place: Antigo vicinity, Ackley Township, Langlade County, WI

brief: Single-span riveted steel Warren pony truss with verticals and an unusual 'continuous' top chord: the end posts curve into the top chord without a hip joint (the chord is spliced from three pieces, heavier in the middle). 61 ft long with a 16 ft roadway; riveted angles with gusset plates, the deck (corrugated metal under gravel) hung above the bottom chord on steel floor beams. No separate railing beyond the truss web and a light rail at mid-height. Carries a crowned gravel township road across a small rocky river among fields and a farmhouse; striped hazard boards at the corners. Measured drawings included.

traits.truss_variant: warren with verticals, curved end post
